purpose: Select the authoritative evidence route required to answer a property-specific proposition, based on the question, date, property status, legal event and proposition type.
source_basis: Tailte Éireann Land Registry and Registry of Deeds services

route_catalogue.limitation: Current register evidence does not automatically answer historical-state questions.
Availability and form of historical records must be confirmed through the official service.

route_catalogue.access_condition: Instrument inspection is subject to the access rules applicable under Land Registration Rules 2012 Rule 159.

route_catalogue.limitation: A registry map/title plan must not be treated as conclusive of every boundary or extent question.

minimum_identifiers: party/name index information and relevant date/property clues
route_catalogue.limitation: A memorial/search result is not automatically the full deed or proof of its legal effect.

route_catalogue.authority: Probate/estate records and relevant official registration records
route_catalogue.limitation: Succession evidence alone does not prove current registered ownership.
Court material must be matched to the property and order/date.

sufficiency_model.meaning: The selected authoritative record directly establishes the requested fact within its legal/evidential scope.
No single record is sufficient, but multiple matched authoritative sources establish the fact together.
The evidence supports the proposition but does not independently establish it.
The evidence cannot establish the requested proposition.

routing_examples.question: Who was registered owner on a historical date?
secondary: REGISTRY_OF_DEEDS_SEARCH if property was then unregistered

routing_examples.question: Did my parent leave this registered house to me?
routing_examples.reason: Entitlement and registered title are distinct propositions.

routing_examples.question: Was there a mortgage on the property on a particular date?
Does this deed prove the property was transferred?
routing_examples.reason: Document content and registration effect are separate questions.

routing_examples.question: Was this property registered before first registration?
routing_examples.reason: The appropriate evidence system depends on the property's registration history.

guardrails: Never select an evidence route solely because it is convenient.
Never use a secondary source when an authoritative route is required and available.
Never treat one record as sufficient for a proposition outside that record's scope.
Never infer that a Registry of Deeds memorial proves the complete legal effect of the underlying deed.
Never treat a succession document as current registered-title evidence.
Never retrieve or publish personal property information without the lawful/appropriate access route and necessary property identifiers.
